settings.title: Settings
settings.host_helper: Public FQDN used by the browser extension and the mobile app, for example credentials.example.com
settings.bootstrap_description: Install the StartCredentials browser extension, connect it to {url} and enter the activation code below. It stops working once the first administrator exists. Activation code: {token}
settings.mail_from_helper: Address used for invitations. Leave empty to use the smarthost account: many providers reject other senders.
settings.min_password_length_helper: 12 to 64 characters. Enforced by the extension and the app on registration, change and recovery: the server never sees the password.
settings.secure_send_helper: Allows sending a credential to an external recipient: link by email, access code shared separately, content encrypted and destroyed after opening.
settings.secure_send_domains_helper: Comma separated. Empty: any domain. Subdomains are allowed too.
